title: Chitin Transmission
description: A single insect sample chopped and striated into a granular swarm that crawls across the stereo field, lurching between forward and reversed playback at half and double speed. Over 24 cycles a band-pass sweep, crush degradation and a slow pan LFO morph it from a tight broken chitter into a wide, hollow alien broadcast.
code:
setcpm(112/4)
stack(
  s("insect*2").n("<0 1 2 1>/2")
    .chop("<8 16 12 32>/8").striate("<1 2 4>/6")
    .speed("<1 -1 0.5 -0.5 2>/2")
    .bpf(sine.slow(24).range(350, 4200)).resonance(sine.slow(13).range(6, 18))
    .crush("<16 8 6 10>/16").coarse("<1 1 2 4>/4")
    .shape(saw.slow(32).range(0.1, 0.45))
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.1, 0.9))
    .sometimesBy(0.2, x => x.speed(-2))
    .off(0.125, x => x.speed(-1).bpf(2600).gain(0.35).pan(0.2))
    .delay("0.4:0.333:0.6").room(sine.slow(16).range(0.2, 0.8))
    .gain(0.85)
)
